The example models that come with the package

Source: R/generate.R
vp_example.Rd

The package includes the variability models and data used in the examples and vignettes:

Usage

vp_example(file = NULL)

Arguments

file

The names of one or more example files. NULL lists them all.

Value

The full paths of the files, or, with file = NULL, the names of all the example files.

Details

  • the Mi Band smart band, in seven generations, as planned and as realised (miband*_planned.uvl, miband*_realized.uvl; miband3.uvl is the Mi Band 3), and variants of the Mi Band 3 that the vignettes use to show special cases (miband3_battery.uvl, miband3_dead.uvl, miband3_void.uvl, miband3_no_ble.uvl, miband3_planned_old.uvl, miband3_wish.uvl, miband3_battery_wish.uvl, miband8_refactored.uvl), with the valid configurations of two of them (miband3_products.csv, miband3_battery_products.csv), a sample of five (sample.csv) and a file of renames (miband3_renames.txt);

  • small models with numbers, imports and other constructs of UVL (tiny_band.uvl, numbers_band.uvl, power_band.uvl, power_band_boolean.uvl, void_numbers.uvl, imports_band.uvl, uvl_tour.uvl);

  • the feature models of axTLS, uClibc and fifteen versions of BusyBox in UVL (axTLS.uvl, uClibc.uvl, busybox_01.uvl to busybox_15.uvl), and a Boolean formula with eleven options of the Linux kernel in DIMACS format (eleven_options.dimacs);

  • the folder busybox: the graphs of 37 monthly versions of BusyBox from the dataset of Strong4VM (doi:10.5281/zenodo.17277788), made by version 1 of Strong4VM, to read with vp_read_history().

See also

Other reading: vp_classify(), vp_expand(), vp_features(), vp_functions(), vp_generate(), vp_history(), vp_igraph(), vp_links(), vp_minimal(), vp_read(), vp_read_history(), vp_read_uvl_tree(), vp_representativeness(), vp_subset()
